name: @stackra/flow-preset
description: Stackra's Figentra Flow preset: the flow-* command texts, templates, agents, rules, skills, guard tables and surfaces that fflow sync renders into a Stackra repository
author: Figentra (https://figentra.com)

stackra.summary: Name it as "preset" in a Stackra repository's flow.config.json (fflow preset add @stackra/flow-preset); change Stackra's agents, rules, skills, templates or guard tables here, never in a repository's rendered copies.
